judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped mid-implementation (as shown by its own `.lore/dod.md` and `Status: In Progress` in the spec). While the core `ajv` validation logic in `ToolRegistry` works, it fails to cache compiled schemas for function-valued tool definitions in a `WeakMap` (recompiling on every call instead) and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. It misses numerous acceptance criteria: it did not update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts`, and its `CHANGELOG.md` entry only mentions registration-time schema compilation rather than runtime execution validation and the required migration note. Furthermore, most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool error, compilation count) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, with only a subset placed in a separate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file.
